name: Chat Files
description: Clear old photos, videos and files that chat apps pile up. Goes to the Trash.
whatsNew: Zephydian is now Zephdeck: updated for the new name.

howTo.goal: Finds old photos, videos and files that chat apps keep piling up, so you can clear them out.
rules: Choose how old files must be, then review what was found before anything moves.
Everything goes to the Trash, so you can still get it back.
Some apps' folders need Full Disk Access first; it says when.
